content.title: What is current NFL Draft order? Who are top NFL Draft prospects? NFL mock drafts, where to watch
content.text: Updated April 20, 2026, 11:59 a.m. ETThe 2026 NFL Draft will take place in Pittsburgh from April 23-25.Various sports analysts have released mock drafts predicting selections for all seven rounds.The Las Vegas Raiders currently hold the first overall pick in the draft.Admission to the draft is free, but fans must register for tickets through the NFL OnePass app or website.The event will be broadcast on NFL Network, ABC, and ESPN, and available to stream on NFL+ and ESPN+.The 2026 NFL Draft rolls into Pittsburgh on Thursday, but who are the prospects to know and what teams are interested?Here's a look at the latest NFL Draft mock drafts, top prospects, draft order, how to watch the NFL Draft, dates and times, and more.NFL mock draft 2026: Where will top NFL Draft prospects go? Who will be NFL Draft No. 1 pick?Mel Kiper Jr., ESPN (2 rounds): Most of his rankings focus on who he feels is the top talent. Kiper's most recent offering predicts who he thinks each NFL team will actually select during the first two rounds with updates after the Giants-Bengals trade involving Dexter Lawrence.Nate Davis, USA Today Sports (1 round): The focus here is how the Lawrence trade affects the first round of this year's draft.Chad Reuter, NFL.com (7 rounds): Goes through all seven rounds while offering a "wide-angle view about where teams can find value" at each position.Garrett Podell, CBS Sports (7 rounds): HIs team-by-team list and analysis covers all three days of the draft.Jordan Reid, ESPN (7 rounds): Gives his take on 257 prospects and who he predicts their new teams will be.2026 NFL mock draft simulatorVisit nflmockdraftdatabase.com and check out the NFL Draft simulator. Fans can generate a mock draft that factors in various mock draft experts' picks and projections for all seven rounds. Plus, take a deeper dive and only focus on your favorite team.2026 NFL Draft prospects: Who are top NFL Draft prospects this year?Mel Kiper Jr., ESPN: Here's a look at his favorite players at each position ahead of the NFL Draft.Daniel Jeremiah, NFL.com: His list of top 50 prospects is led by Indiana's Fernando Mendoza and Notre Dame's Jermiyah Love.Bucky Brooks, NFL.com: This list takes a look at the top 5 draft prospects at each position.Michael Middlehurst-Schwartz, USA Today: Here's a look at some of the high-risk, high-reward prospects available in the NFL Draft.2026 NFL Draft order, first round: Who has NFL Draft No. 1 pick?Visit nfl.com to see the 2026 NFL Draft order for all seven rounds. Here is a look at the first round:Las Vegas RaidersNew York JetsArizona CardinalsTennessee TitansNew York GiantsCleveland BrownsWashington CommandersNew Orleans SaintsKansas City ChiefsNew York Giants (via Cincinnati Bengals)Miami DolphinsDallas CowboysLos Angeles Rams (via Atlanta Falcons)Baltimore RavensTampa Bay BuccaneersNew York Jets (via Indianapolis Colts)Detroit LionsMinnesota VikingsCarolina PanthersDallas Cowboys (from Green Bay Packers)Pittsburgh SteelersLos Angeles ChargersPhiladelphia EaglesCleveland Browns (from Jacksonville Jaguars)Chicago BearsBuffalo BillsSan Francisco 49ersHouston TexansKansas City Chiefs (from Los Angeles Rams)Miami Dolphins (from Denver Broncos)New England PatriotsSeattle SeahawksColts NFL Draft picks 2026: When do Indianapolis Colts pick? How many Colts draft picks this year?The Indianapolis Colts currently hold seven picks in the 2026 NFL Draft. However, the team doesn't possess a first-round selection.Round 2: 47th overallRound 3: 78th overallRound 4: 113th overallRound 5: 156th overallRound 6: 214th overallRound 7: 249th overallRound 7: 254th overallColts NFL mock draft: Who will Indianapolis Colts pick in second round of 2026 NFL Draft? What will Chris Ballard do?The latest version of a Colts mock draft from Nathan Brown has Colts GM Chris Ballard wheeling and dealing in an attempt to secure another second-round pick for the 2026 NFL Draft, which means trading back from No. 47. But who are the two coveted prospects that Brown has in mind?Round 2, pick No. 56: Malachi Lawrence, UCF, edge rusher, seniorRound 2, pick No. 62: Anthony Hill Jr., Texas, linebacker, junior2026 NFL Draft prospects: Indiana footballKaelon Black, RBPat Coogan, COmar Cooper Jr., WRAiden Fisher, LBMikail Kamara, DEFernando Mendoza, QBLouis Moore, SRiley Nowakowski, TED'Angelo Ponds, CBElijah Sarratt, WR2026 NFL Draft prospects: Notre Dame footballTosh Baker, OTMalachi Fields, WRJeremiyah Love, RBJadarian Price, RBEli Raridon, TEBilly Schrauth, OGJalen Stroman, SAamil Wagner, OTWhere is 2026 NFL Draft location this year?The 2026 NFL Draft will take place outside of Acrisure Stadium in Pittsburgh. The North Shore of the Allegheny River outside the stadium will serve as a "natural amphitheater" for the Draft Theater and Main Stage.Point State Park will host a free fan festival − the NFL Draft Experience. Visit nfl.com for hours of operation.When is 2026 NFL Draft date? What time does NFL Draft start?The 2026 NFL Draft will take place April 23-25:Thursday, April 23 − Round 1: 8 p.m. ET / 7 p.m. CTFriday, April 24 − Rounds 2-3: 7 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. CTSaturday, April 25 − Rounds 4-7: Noon ET / 7 p.m. CT2026 NFL Draft tickets are free? How to get NFL Draft tickets at Acrisure Stadium in PittsburghAdmission is free to the 2026 NFL Draft. Fans must either download NFL OnePass (Apple / Google Play) or visit NFL.com/DraftAccess to register for tickets. Visit nfl.com for detailed event information.Where to watch 2026 NFL Draft: What channel is NFL Draft on this year?The 2026 NFL Draft will air on NFL Network, ABC, ESPN, and ESPN Deportes.Watch the NFL Draft on FuboHow to stream 2026 NFL DraftThe 2026 NFL Draft will stream on NFL+ (Apple / Google Play). Fans can also download ESPN+ (Apple / Google Play).Watch the NFL Draft with ESPNNFL schedule 2026: When is NFL schedule release date?The NFL has yet to confirm a date for the 2026 NFL schedule release. However, ESPN NFL reporter Adam Schefter recently speculated the new NFL schedule could arrive between Tuesday, May 12 and Thursday, May 14.Chris Sims is a trending reporter at Midwest Connect Gannett. Follow him on Twitter: @ChrisFSims.
